repeatedSQLAlchemyCalls.verdict: Repeated real call sites or chained-call multiplicity; no missing/unexplained edge.

repeatedDuckDBCall.verdict: Repeated replace call sites in generated table loop; no missing/unexplained edge.

OTPLookalike.verdict: OTP ASN.1 data lookalike under .py; corpus-invalid residual.

repeatedOverrideDeclarations.verdict: Repeated same-named method declarations across nested SQLAlchemy classes produce multiple legal override sites; no missing/unexplained edge.

repeatedInheritanceDeclarations.verdict: Repeated same-named Comparator inheritance declarations; no missing/unexplained edge.

rule: Multiplicity-only residuals are closed by named source-site counts and corpus-policy evidence, not by removing direct edges.
